reviews.x: The sprayer is perfect and exactly what I wanted.  I was afraid I'd break the glass so I bought a drink coozy to put over the bottle.  LOL

I was really worried, when I first received my order, that all I was going to find inside the box was a bunch of colored glass. Thankfully, the box they came in was better packed than the one they shipped in. So far these bottles seem to be amazing, the only complaint I have is the lid (not the spray nozzle) desires to go on cross-threaded; it's very hard to get it to line up properly. That's not enough to complain about though.

These have been great! Awesome quality, came packaged with care (not just thrown in a box), the nozzle is great and sprays in a nice mist. I have used it to make DIY air fresheners--mixing baking soda with essential oils. The bottle have not clogged after months of use. Package included 2 sheets of sticker labels and bottle caps in case you want to take the nozzle off at any time.
High quality and the sprayer is the best. Quality and low price is a real winner. I make Thieves household cleaner to give as gifts. Perfect.
These glass spray bottles are perfect for my Essential Oils cleaning mixture.  Attractive  good price.  Exactly what I wanted
As described. We ordered the bronze ones as well. The pump on all are high quality. They didn’t seem flimsy whatsoever.

I have been using these for a few weeks now and I LOVE them! The sprayer works extremely well and is comfortable in the hand. The only time I'be had a problem with the lid untwisting is when I use my right hand and push it. I use one for essential oil water (use on my hair) and the other for vinegar water with essential oils (cleaning).

reviews.t: All Glass,glorious Cobalt color & it is what it states the product to be
reviews.x: All glass, beautiful blue glass. Well made, sprayer is adjustable, works well, with great, consistent pressure. Delivered in perfect condition, as stated. Seller is communicative. Good price!

Love these spray bottles work. They work well and even hubby likes them

reviews.t: Use them with my oil cleaner!
reviews.x: These are awesome for mixing cleaning products in.

The labels they provided though, were for the tops of baby food jars so I couldn't use them. I bought separately, 2 silicone holders for the bottoms of the bottles, which makes them even better. Great spray bottles, just comes with stickers/labels that aren't for these, for some reason. I will definitely order more, they are really solid

This is the best bottle and the spray function works perfectly.  This is my second lot purchase , previous orders of the bottles I have used for home and works brilliantly and effortlessly.  Pump quality was good and the spray function was excactly what the seller described, it even sprays in midst which works brilliantly for my fragrance spray for my beddings.  Thank you

The bottles do not indicate that they're made anywhere, but the Amazon listing says they're made in USA. I hope that's correct.  The cobalt glass bottles are sturdy and arrived intact.  The sprayers are impressively good. They work well and feel sturdy.

I really like the blue glass bottle. It's attractive and can sit out on my counter, I don't feel I need to hide it in the cupboard. So far all  the ones I've purchased have a nice spray that covers a sizeable area. Really like these spray bottles!

I should have bought the 4 pack cause I use these to fill with colloidal silver and essential oils and clean my house. I need one in all my rooms! The sprayer works great and the blue bottle is beautiful to look at. Great product.

These even come with caps so you don't have to leave your sprayer submerged.  These are priced well and the supplier is super responsive.  If you need glass sprayers, these should be high on the list.

reviews.t: Spray attachments get brittle and break
reviews.x: These were great until one of the spray attachments broke at the neck. All I did was pick it up and it snapped. Now I'm back to square one trying to find a durable spray attachment.
One of our bottles was delivered with a broken hose. To use this one I have to spray with the bottle upside down, not a big deal but a little inconvenient. The other works great!
Good and sturdy.  Sprays really well without any misses, or clogs.  Using it for my essential oils and it’s been wonderful so far.  Want to order more, for my bathrooms!

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the sprayers as high quality and working well, often describing a nice mist or consistent spray.
Many customers use these bottles for DIY cleaners and essential oil mixtures, and report they hold up well over months of use.
The bottles are described as sturdy, well-made, and good value for the price.
A few reviewers report problems with the nozzles, including a stream instead of a fan spray and nozzles breaking within a year.
Some reviewers mention the lid or nozzle-to-bottle junction, with one noting the lid can untwist when pushed with the right hand.
